title: Shells, notifications và help entry
scope_items: Canonical Goose SQL migration (infra/migrations/00004_p0_08_notifications_and_help_center.sql) creating notifications (§26.13 tenant-scoped with ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), global kb_categories, kb_articles, kb_article_versions, and article_ratings with explicit app_user and admin_user grants, down drops, and zero-float decimal adherence

Compiled NotificationService, HelpService, and DashboardService Protobuf contracts (protos/creativanta/admin/v1/notification.proto, protos/creativanta/admin/v1/help.proto, protos/creativanta/admin/v1/dashboard.proto) and 4-target generated artifacts (Go, Go Connect, TypeScript ES, Dart/Flutter gRPC)

Go API Backend Services: Notification service (apps/api/internal/notification) with tenant isolation, unread counter, priority sort, mark-all-read and preferences; Help service (apps/api/internal/help) with contextual module filtering, 90-day stale article flags, and internal admin isolation; Home Decision Engine (apps/api/internal/home) with 6 canonical operator mode identity retention, transparent unbuilt action unavailability, strict demo fixture isolation from customer totals, 'Why this number' KPI explanations, and 5-step closed-loop onboarding sequence

Web Application Shell (apps/web): 6-mode switcher, Notification Drawer with unread badges, contextual Help Drawer with module search, 'Why this number' drilldown modal, 4 UI state switchers (normal, loading, empty, error/repair), strict customer vs demo data isolation, WCAG 2.1 AA a11y labels, and vi-VN i18n base
Admin Shell (apps/admin): Access control helpers enforcing internal admin role isolation and 90-day stale article thresholds

Mobile Application Shell (apps/mobile): NotificationBottomSheet with mark-read/dismiss actions, HelpBottomSheet with contextual article search, WhyThisNumberBottomSheet enforcing strict demo isolation, 6-mode switcher, 4 UI states switcher, and full test suite passing in Flutter 3.47.9
verified_sub_slices: Six operator mode identities retained and verified across Go backend, web shell, and mobile shell (TestSixModeIdentitiesRetained, modes.test.ts, shell_notifications_help_test.dart)

Unbuilt action unavailable with explanation: every disabled CTA explicitly documents missing prerequisite/unbuilt module without fake success or silent failure (TestUnbuiltActionUnavailableWithExplanation, home.test.ts, widget_test.dart)

No demo data in customer totals: verified customer metrics (0 VND) are strictly partitioned from preview/demo fixtures with DEMO badge and non-aggregation invariants (TestNoDemoDataInCustomerTotals, WhyThisNumberModal, shell_notifications_help_test.dart)

Scoped notification system: tenant-scoped notifications, mark-read, mark-all-read, dismiss-from-active, and category preferences verified with thread-race detector (TestScopedAccessAndTenantIsolation, notification.test.ts, NotificationDrawer)

Contextual help system: search by current module filter, 90-day stale article flag, helpful/unhelpful rating updates, and internal admin role gate verified (TestSearchContextualModuleFilter, TestStaleArticleDetection, HelpDrawer)
Up and Down SQL statements in 00004_p0_08_notifications_and_help_center.sql validated by pglast PostgreSQL AST parser and static contract validator
